evidence_items.finding: gross margin has compressed from 44% to 29% over 18 months — a 15 percentage point decline — while wholesale prices charged to clients have not changed
evidence_items.rationale: Margin compression with static pricing is the primary financial health signal. Paraphrased from symptoms. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: flour, butter, and egg costs have risen approximately 35% over the same 18-month period with no adjustment to wholesale rates charged to cafes and restaurants
evidence_items.rationale: Ingredient cost inflation without repricing is the direct driver of margin compression. No must_identify terms.

evidence_items.finding: owner is reducing personal drawings to cover the operating shortfall caused by the margin decline
evidence_items.rationale: Owner drawing reduction is a direct financial distress indicator. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: artisan bakery; annual revenue $680K; 6 employees; gross margin 18 months ago 44%; current gross margin 29%; ingredient cost increase approximately 35% across core inputs
evidence_items.rationale: Structured summary from facts_known_to_owner. Margin change from 44% to 29% = -15 percentage points. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): revenue has grown 12% over the same 18-month period
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue growth is a misleading signal masking the margin destruction from cost inflation.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the order book remains fully committed with no client cancellations
evidence_items.rationale: Full order book is a misleading positive signal — demand strength does not indicate margin health.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): clients have provided positive feedback on product quality
evidence_items.rationale: Client satisfaction is a misleading signal unrelated to input cost inflation.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: Margin compressed from 44% to 29% — profitChangePercent proxy = -15 percentage points; marginPct set as change value

validation_notes: HOL-02-001 is a cost-inflation margin erosion case. All findings derived from input_packet. No must_identify vocabulary used. marginPct set to -15 (44% to 29% compression).
